## Details

<a id="arena2_screen"></a>
### [`arena2_screen`](../../../../src/graphics/arena2_screen.asm#L6) `$E000-$E3E7`

*data*

Screen RAM of the arena that is not on screen, 40 bytes for each row. $8f72 swaps rows 7-22, columns 4-35 with $4400. The hit record fault of check_attack_hit also reads $e3d9-$e3dc and $e3e1-$e3e4.

- **Read by:** [`check_attack_hit`](../combat/hits.md#check_attack_hit), [`apply_hit_damage`](../combat/hits.md#apply_hit_damage), [`spawn_hit_sprite`](../combat/hits.md#spawn_hit_sprite)
- **Referred to by:** [`swap_centre_colours`](../screen/scene.md#swap_centre_colours)

<a id="arena2_screen_tail"></a>
### [`arena2_screen_tail`](../../../../src/graphics/arena2_screen.asm#L133) `$E3E8-$E3FF`

*data*

The same 24 bytes as $47e8-$47ff: the screen RAM after the screen, with the sprite pointers.

- **Read by:** [`check_attack_hit`](../combat/hits.md#check_attack_hit), [`apply_hit_damage`](../combat/hits.md#apply_hit_damage), [`spawn_hit_sprite`](../combat/hits.md#spawn_hit_sprite)

<a id="arena2_colours"></a>
### [`arena2_colours`](../../../../src/graphics/arena2_screen.asm#L140) `$E400-$E7E7`

*data*

Colour RAM of the arena that is not on screen. $8f72 swaps rows 7-22, columns 4-35 with $d800. The hit record fault of check_attack_hit also reads $e7e1-$e7e4.

- **Read by:** [`check_attack_hit`](../combat/hits.md#check_attack_hit), [`apply_hit_damage`](../combat/hits.md#apply_hit_damage), [`spawn_hit_sprite`](../combat/hits.md#spawn_hit_sprite)

<a id="arena2_colours_tail"></a>
### [`arena2_colours_tail`](../../../../src/graphics/arena2_screen.asm#L267) `$E7E8-$E7FF`

*data*

24 bytes after the colours. Bits 0-3 are colours. Bits 4-7 vary, as in bytes read from the colour RAM, which keeps only 4 bits.

- **Read by:** [`check_attack_hit`](../combat/hits.md#check_attack_hit), [`apply_hit_damage`](../combat/hits.md#apply_hit_damage), [`spawn_hit_sprite`](../combat/hits.md#spawn_hit_sprite)
